title: Speak, my soul
identity: Roydon Tse's Speak, my soul (2016) is for alto saxophone and piano, about five minutes; its sustained notes are a specific documented challenge.

evidence.claim: Composer page gives scoring, date, duration, commission, slow/simple harmonic profile, long sustained notes, performance history and a linked video.
Composer's page offers score and parts for sale; no public notation preview.

review_focus: Inference from the composer’s note: the sustained writing and slow pacing invite attention to breath management, tone stability, and phrase shaping; these observations are compatible with the composer’s description of the work as simple.
collection_flag: Commissioned work performed by professional/college-affiliated saxophonists; this supports recital context, not a difficulty assignment.
gaps: Score is paywalled; no notation was inspected.
Composer-linked video was identified but not played; no recording details beyond the page metadata are claimed.
Complete written range and note-level demands remain unknown without the score.
